Proposed: Brakel
research: The archival abstract places Jürgen Henrich Rosenberg and other defendants at Brakel in a benefice dispute. The Brakel citizenship register and ai_2026.json document a local Rosenberg burgher group, including Henrich Jürgen in 1704; the similar name and place support a tentative Brakel attribution, but do not prove that the two men are identical or exclude another local family. No connection to a noble Rosenberg house is shown. Register: https://www.lwl.org/westfaelische-geschichte/txt/beitrwff-9453.pdf
